scripts.build: pnpm exec tsc && vite build -c src/main/vite.config.ts && vite build -c src/renderer/vite.config.ts
scripts.build:types: tsc --project tsconfig.main.json --emitDeclarationOnly && tsc --project tsconfig.renderer.json --emitDeclarationOnly && pnpm run copy:types
scripts.copy:types: cpy dist/main/main/createIPCHandler.d.ts dist/createIPCHandler.d.ts && cpy dist/main/main/exposeElectronTRPC.d.ts dist/exposeElectronTRPC.d.ts && cpy dist/main/main/types.d.ts dist/types.d.ts && cpy dist/main/main/handleIPCMessage.d.ts dist/handleIPCMessage.d.ts && cpy dist/renderer/renderer/ipcLink.d.ts dist/ipcLink.d.ts && cpy dist/renderer/renderer/utils.d.ts dist/utils.d.ts && echo 'export * from "./createIPCHandler";' > dist/main.d.ts && echo 'export * from "./exposeElectronTRPC";' >> dist/main.d.ts && echo 'export * from "./types";' >> dist/main.d.ts && echo 'export * from "./handleIPCMessage";' >> dist/main.d.ts
